import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import *

def fn():
    # one attempt carrying both internal and external evidence -> mixed
    m = {"version":1,"seed":8,"low_count":1,"attempts":2,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100,
         "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":0,"scopes":[{"id":"s","prefix":"2001:db8::/64","subnets":[0]}]}]}
    pl = run_ok(['plan', wmanifest(m)])
    t1 = pl['probes'][0]['target']
    rows = [{"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","received_ms":0,"target":t1,"source":t1,"type":129,"code":0},
            {"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","received_ms":1,"target":t1,"source":"2001:db8:ffff::9","type":1,"code":3}]
    rep = run_ok(['replay', wmanifest(m), wf('b.jsonl', ''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in rows))])
    s = rep['segments'][0]; tgt = s['targets'][0]
    assert tgt['classification'] == 'mixed', tgt
    assert tgt['internal_attempts'] == [0] and tgt['external_attempts'] == [0], tgt
    assert tgt['external_sources'] == ['2001:db8:ffff::9'], tgt
    assert tgt['silent_attempts'] == [1], tgt
    assert s['internal'] == [t1] and s['external'] == ['2001:db8:ffff::9'] and s['overlap'] == [], s
    assert s['state'] == 'usable' and s['exposure'] == 'observed_internal_reply'
check('same attempt mixed evidence', fn)

def fn():
    # address failure wins over unknown probe, time and icmp
    m = {"version":1,"seed":8,"low_count":1,"attempts":1,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100,
         "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":0,"scopes":[{"id":"s","prefix":"2001:db8::/64","subnets":[0]}]}]}
    row = {"probe_id":"nope","received_ms":-99,"target":"2001:db9::1","source":"bad","type":7,"code":9}
    rep = run_ok(['replay', wmanifest(m), wf('c.jsonl', json.dumps(row)+'\n')])
    assert rep['diagnostics'] == [{"line":1,"reason":"address"}], rep['diagnostics']
check('address precedence over all later reasons', fn)

def fn():
    # prefix spelling must not change replay evidence
    m1 = {"version":1,"seed":3,"low_count":2,"attempts":2,"spacing_ms":5,"timeout_ms":50,
          "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":0,"scopes":[{"id":"s","prefix":"2001:db8:1234:5600::/56","subnets":[7]}]}]}
    m2 = json.loads(json.dumps(m1))
    m2['windows'][0]['scopes'][0]['prefix'] = '2001:0DB8:1234:5600:0000:0000:0000:0000/56'
    pl = run_ok(['plan', wmanifest(m1)])
    t1 = pl['probes'][0]['target']; t2 = pl['probes'][2]['target']
    rows = [{"probe_id":"w/s/7/low-1/0","received_ms":0,"target":t1,"source":t1,"type":129,"code":0},
            {"probe_id":"w/s/7/low-2/1","received_ms":16,"target":t2,"source":"2001:DB8:FFFF::A","type":1,"code":1},
            {"probe_id":"w/s/7/low-2/1","received_ms":16,"target":t2,"source":"2001:db8:ffff::a","type":1,"code":1}]
    r1 = run_ok(['replay', wmanifest(m1), wf('d1.jsonl', ''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in rows))])
    r2 = run_ok(['replay', wmanifest(m2), wf('d2.jsonl', ''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in rows))])
    assert r1 == r2, (r1, r2)
    assert r1['accepted_rows'] == 2 and r1['duplicate_rows'] == 1
    s = r1['segments'][0]
    assert s['network'] == '2001:db8:1234:5607::/64', s['network']
    assert s['internal'] == [t1] and s['external'] == ['2001:db8:ffff::a'], s
check('prefix spelling independence in replay', fn)

def fn():
    # canary hit in any attempt; duplicate hits collapse
    m = {"version":1,"seed":5,"low_count":1,"attempts":3,"spacing_ms":1,"timeout_ms":10,
         "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":0,"scopes":[{"id":"s","prefix":"2001:db8::/64","subnets":[0]}]}]}
    pl = run_ok(['plan', wmanifest(m)])
    can = [p for p in pl['probes'] if p['role']=='canary']
    c0 = [p for p in can if p['slot']==0]; c1 = [p for p in can if p['slot']==1]
    rows = []
    for p in c0 + c1:
        rows.append({"probe_id":p['id'],"received_ms":p['sent_ms'],"target":p['target'],
                     "source":p['target'],"type":129,"code":0})
        rows.append({"probe_id":p['id'],"received_ms":p['sent_ms'],"target":p['target'],
                     "source":p['target'].upper(),"type":129,"code":0})
    rep = run_ok(['replay', wmanifest(m), wf('e.jsonl', ''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in rows))])
    s = rep['segments'][0]
    assert s['canary_hits'] == [0,1], s
    assert s['state'] == 'alias_suspect' and s['exposure'] == 'excluded'
    assert rep['accepted_rows'] == 6 and rep['duplicate_rows'] == 6, (rep['accepted_rows'], rep['duplicate_rows'])
    assert s['targets'][0]['classification'] == 'alias_suspect'
    assert s['targets'][0]['silent_attempts'] == [0,1,2], s['targets'][0]
check('canary hits across attempts with duplicates', fn)

def fn():
    # a low target that is also an external source of another target -> overlap, ambiguous
    m = {"version":1,"seed":5,"low_count":3,"attempts":1,"spacing_ms":1,"timeout_ms":10,
         "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":0,"scopes":[{"id":"s","prefix":"2001:db8::/64","subnets":[0]}]}]}
    pl = run_ok(['plan', wmanifest(m)])
    t = {p['slot']: p['target'] for p in pl['probes'] if p['role']=='low'}
    rows = [{"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-2/0","received_ms":1,"target":t[2],"source":t[2],"type":129,"code":0},
            {"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-3/0","received_ms":2,"target":t[3],"source":t[2],"type":1,"code":0}]
    rep = run_ok(['replay', wmanifest(m), wf('f.jsonl', ''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in rows))])
    s = rep['segments'][0]
    assert s['internal'] == [t[2]] and s['external'] == [t[2]] and s['overlap'] == [t[2]], s
    assert s['state'] == 'ambiguous'
    # all targets classified ambiguous, raw evidence retained
    assert [x['classification'] for x in s['targets']] == ['ambiguous']*3
    assert s['targets'][0]['silent_attempts'] == [0]
    assert s['targets'][1]['internal_attempts'] == [0] and s['targets'][1]['silent_attempts'] == []
    assert s['targets'][2]['external_attempts'] == [0] and s['targets'][2]['external_sources'] == [t[2]]
check('overlap via a peer low target', fn)

def fn():
    # alias_suspect wins even when overlap exists; raw sets retained
    m = {"version":1,"seed":5,"low_count":2,"attempts":1,"spacing_ms":1,"timeout_ms":10,
         "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":0,"scopes":[{"id":"s","prefix":"2001:db8::/64","subnets":[0]}]}]}
    pl = run_ok(['plan', wmanifest(m)])
    t = {p['slot']: p['target'] for p in pl['probes'] if p['role']=='low'}
    can = {p['slot']: p for p in pl['probes'] if p['role']=='canary'}
    rows = [{"probe_id":can[0]['id'],"received_ms":can[0]['sent_ms'],"target":can[0]['target'],
             "source":can[0]['target'],"type":129,"code":0},
            {"probe_id":can[1]['id'],"received_ms":can[1]['sent_ms'],"target":can[1]['target'],
             "source":can[1]['target'],"type":129,"code":0},
            {"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","received_ms":0,"target":t[1],"source":t[1],"type":129,"code":0},
            {"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-2/0","received_ms":1,"target":t[2],"source":t[1],"type":1,"code":5}]
    rep = run_ok(['replay', wmanifest(m), wf('g.jsonl', ''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in rows))])
    s = rep['segments'][0]
    assert s['state'] == 'alias_suspect' and s['canary_hits'] == [0,1], s
    assert s['overlap'] == [t[1]], s
    assert s['internal'] == [t[1]] and s['external'] == [t[1]]
    assert s['targets'][0]['classification'] == 'alias_suspect'
    assert s['targets'][0]['internal_attempts'] == [0]
    assert s['targets'][1]['external_attempts'] == [0] and s['targets'][1]['external_sources'] == [t[1]]
check('alias_suspect retains raw evidence', fn)

sys.exit(report())
